## Change

Describe the concrete case or correction and link its original source

## Evidence

- [ ] Source URL, posting account, UTC source date, category and allowed type are recorded
- [ ] Title and takeaway describe what is actually demonstrated
- [ ] Prompt text is exact and source-linked, or omitted when unavailable
- [ ] Related excerpts, sponsorship and author-reported numbers are identified
- [ ] All source attachments have a public R2 disposition; video has a poster and playable link

## Synchronization

- [ ] English README and curated JSON, CSV and Markdown index agree
- [ ] All ten localized READMEs preserve case identity, order, media and source links
- [ ] Titles, takeaways and notes are translated; Prompt/code blocks are unchanged
- [ ] No API/Skill installer or unrelated repository release work is added

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 scripts/verify_repo.py` passes
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes
- [ ] Network links and GitHub-rendered media were checked for this change

Include command output and any unresolved evidence limits
